name: lidocaine + prilocaine + tetracaine
purpose: Purpose Deep numbness fast and painless
uses: Uses After cleaning the skin(warm water is better), apply appropriate amount of tattoo cream to the area to be tattooed, wrap the plastic wrap,. Wait 40 minutes to an hour for the numbing cream to take effect. And then get tattooed.
otcwarn: Do not use on damaged or broken skin. Stop use and ask a doctor if rash occurs.

src.label: Hilook Numbing Cream
